about: Tasks to try the skill on: each prompt is the slash command as typed. `expect` and `reject` are regular expressions over the files written and the commands run (the transcript). A match is a first look only; the report must show migrate (twice), typecheck, lint, test, build, docker build and helm results.

evals.prompt: /nuvraxis-fullstack:scaffold-fullstack portal (run in a repo created by /nuvraxis-frontend:scaffold-frontend-app portal)

expect.why: The layer is applied by the script, not rewritten by hand.
Script-written JSON is formatted before linting.
db:generate is a no-op on a fresh scaffold.
The second migrate run proves idempotence.
The chart renders the migrate Job.
The report flags the example action as unauthenticated.

reject.why: push is never part of the scaffold.

expect.why: Tells the user the exact command to run first.
Says how to install the frontend plugin if it's missing.

reject.why: Nothing is created without a frontend scaffold.
Doesn't try to run the frontend scaffold's script itself.

expect.why: Reports that the layer was added before and stops.

reject.why: Never deletes the existing database package.
